It's the Mask of Truth, but again Absolute Cinema 🙌

It's finally here, and it's great. If you've played the first Zan, all you need to know is that this game is a massive improvement. There's much more content, including new side stories that weren't in Mask of Truth, much better cutscenes, and more complex gameplay. If you felt like the first game seemed like a neat idea but was a bit half-baked, you'll be much happier with Zan 2. With that said, people should still be aware that the story here is still a heavily abridged version of Utawarerumono: Mask of Truth, the third in a series of very story-heavy visual novels. If you care about the story at all, you [i]need[/i] to play the main three games in this series before this one (Prelude to the Fallen -> Mask of Deception -> Mask of Truth), or else you will be both incredibly confused and spoiled. You can skip Zan 1 if you're not interested in that, but I very strongly recommend playing all of the others. On a technical note, I'll just mention that this game runs perfectly smoothly for me. Unfortunately, there are basically zero graphical options; the game's internal rendering is locked at 1080p with no anti-aliasing. On the up side, it runs at a very smooth 60 FPS with zero skips or stuttering. It runs smoothly on the Steam Deck, too, so it's probably fine on lower-end systems as well. Hopefully they'll add some more options, but it's perfectly playable even if they don't.

[後半に日本語レビューあり] [h1] The Pinnacle of the "Utawarerumono" Series Action RPG, a Legitimate Evolution from its Predecessor [/h1] What cannot be ignored when discussing this title is the series' long history and its significant changes. For over 20 years, the series reigned as a masterpiece blending beautiful 2D adventures with simulation RPGs, and it was in the 2018 predecessor that it first challenged 3D action. However, that attempt was not entirely smooth sailing, and it occasionally received harsh evaluations from dedicated fans. This game takes those reflections seriously, transcending the boundaries of a mere action spin-off to establish its significance as a full-fledged action RPG that heavily portrays both story and character growth. A strong will to redefine the series' long-cultivated, heavy war chronicles and the inner lives of each character through modern action expressions can be felt throughout. The dramatic evolution of the adventure part is decisive in drawing players into the story. By boldly renovating the traditional 2D sprite format and introducing full production using 3D character models, movements on the battlefield and momentary emotions during conversations are conveyed more vividly. The grand narrative, fitting for the conclusion of the main series trilogy, is colored by dynamic camera work and high-quality full voice acting. Furthermore, the newly added full-voiced "Bujinden" scenarios, which complement the original work, are wonderful as fanservice that deeply explores the bonds between characters; those who love this story are bound to be overwhelmed by its density. The combat system has increased in enjoyment, moving beyond a mere imitation of the "Musou" genre. It brilliantly reproduces the series' traditional "Chain Attack" system within real-time action, balancing the exhilaration of inputs at precise timings with strategic depth according to the situation. The newly introduced skill-board style growth system and the equipment collection cycle with hack-and-slash elements provide purpose and a sense of achievement to action that tends to become monotonous. The process of thoroughly strengthening your favorite characters through your preferred style of growth is easy to get absorbed in, and the wealth of replayability elements, including high-difficulty missions available after clearing the game, far exceeds the previous title. Even in terms of visuals, the charm of the heroines moving vibrantly in 3D is exceptional. Maintaining the framework of a serious action RPG while refusing to compromise on the "cuteness" expected of a character game is likely the best gift for fans of the series. The PC version's optimization is not bad; while it might not feature ultra-high resolution or top-tier graphics, it offers a very stable frame rate, allowing players to comfortably enjoy battlefields where flashy effects fly about. The settings are simple, and the fact that one can immerse themselves in the grinding loop for character growth is another charm that fits modern gaming styles. Overall, it is a work that firmly resolves the dissatisfactions of the previous game and is worthy of the series' finale. It is a title worth considering not only for fans well-versed in the original work but also for those seeking a character-driven, robust action RPG. [h1] 前作から正統進化した『うたわれるもの』シリーズアクションRPGの到達点 [/h1] 本作を語る上で外せないのは、シリーズの長い歴史と大きな変化だ。20年以上もの間、美しい2DアドベンチャーとシミュレーションRPGを融合させた金字塔として君臨してきたシリーズが、初めて3Dアクションに挑戦したのは2018年の前作のことだった。しかし、その試みは順風満帆とは言えず、熱心なファンからは厳しい評価を受けることもあった。本作は、その反省を真摯に受け止め、単なるアクションの派生作という枠を超え、物語と育成を重厚に描き出す本格的なアクションRPGとしての存在意義を確立している。シリーズが長年培ってきた重厚な戦記と、キャラクター一人ひとりの内面を、現代的なアクションの表現で再定義しようとする強い意志が、随所に感じられる。 アドベンチャーパートの劇的な進化が、物語への感情移入を向上させている。従来の2D立ち絵形式を大胆に刷新し、キャラクターの3Dモデルによるフル演出を導入したことで、戦場での動きや、会話の一瞬の感情がより鮮明に伝わるようになった。メインシリーズ三部作の完結編としてふさわしい壮大な物語が、ダイナミックなカメラワークと高品質なフルボイスによって彩られている。さらに、原作を補完する形で追加されたフルボイスの新シナリオ「武人伝」は、キャラクター同士の絆を深く掘り下げるファンサービスとして大変素晴らしく、この物語を愛する者ほど、その濃密さに圧倒されるはずだ。 戦闘システムは、単なる「無双系」の模倣に留まらない面白みが増している。シリーズ伝統の「連撃」システムをリアルタイムアクションで見事に再現し、正確なタイミングでの入力による爽快感と、状況に応じた戦略性が両立している。新しく導入されたスキルボード形式の育成システムや、ハクスラ要素を持つ装備収集のサイクルは、単調になりがちなアクションに目的と達成感を与えている。お気に入りのキャラクターを自分好みの育成で徹底的に強化していく過程は夢中になりやすく、クリア後にも用意された高難易度ミッションを含めたやり込み要素の充実ぶりは、前作を大きく上回る。 ビジュアル面においても、3Dで生き生きと動くヒロインたちの魅力は格別だ。本格的なアクションRPGとしての骨格を維持しつつも、キャラクターゲームとしての「可愛らしさ」を妥協していない点は、シリーズファンにとって最高のプレゼントだろう。PC版の最適化も悪くなく、超高解像度/高画質という訳ではないが非常に安定したフレームレートで、派手なエフェクトが飛び交う戦場を快適に楽しめる。設定項目はシンプルで、キャラクターの育成周回に没頭できる点も、現代のゲームスタイルに合う魅力と言えるだろう。 総じて、前作の不満点をしっかり解消し、シリーズ完結編にふさわしい作品だ。原作を熟知しているファンはもちろん、キャラクター主導の骨太なアクションRPGを求める層にとっても、本作は検討する価値のある一作だといえるだろう。 [quote][b]Check out our Steam curator ([url=store.steampowered.com/curator/36364102-Horny-Hentai-Festival/]link[/url]) , YouTube channel ([url=www.youtube.com/curatorhhf/]link[/url]), and X(Twitter) ([url=x.com/hhfcurator]link[/url])![/b][/quote]

《传颂之物：斩 2》（Utawarerumono: ZAN 2）是 AQUAPLUS 在传颂之物系列制作的衍生3D动作无双割草RPG。前作《斩1》算是该系列转变动作方向的第一部作品，瑕疵稍多。而有了前作的经验，本作《斩2》无论是在剧情叙事方面，还是角色动作方面又或者是战斗系统方面都是全面的进步。 游戏的主线剧情完整改编自《传颂之物：二人的白皇》，也是承接了《斩1》结局哈克以奥修特尔的身份活下去，维护与效忠公主殿下。以“恩纳卡姆依”为根据地来对抗被反派控制了的大和朝廷，协助公主殿下进行拨乱反正。 游戏的玩法与前作相似，保留了原作《白皇》的ADV式剧情流程，在各章节的战斗间隙加入了大量的3D动画演出，同时对剧情进行了很大程度的精简，一些剧情叙事是在以旁白的形式来简略的讲述一些事情的前因旧果。但本作比起前作《斩1》来说有所改进，流程中主要的情节以及一些名场面都得到了保留，同时还在主线之外加入了很多新的日常情节，在各章节的“武士传”能够看到。 战斗方面，虽然大体是无双割草，但也不是一通乱打就完了。游戏有十多个难度的区分，主要是敌人的强度，还有角色的经验点数的倍率，越高的难度奖励加成也会变高，提升角色的培育效率。本作在战斗很直观的就能感受到本作在打击反馈、武器手感、角色动作、技能释放等等方面比前作好了很多。随着流程的推进，主角队伍也会逐渐扩充，但依旧是让玩家自由搭配来组成一支可在战斗中即时切换的四人小队。不同的角色有不同的攻击武器、战斗定位、战斗方式还有技能。战斗的胜利会给队伍角色积累经验进行升级，同时还能在角色面板进行属性和技能的强化。同时游戏也保留了前作装备卷轴的设定，像是攻击、防御、士气、回复等等等等丰富的效果进行搭配选择。任务时的目标倒是和前作大差不差，进入一些场景金进行战斗，有着主要目标与次要目标，然后一些奖励。不过战斗还是在敌人的锁定方面做得不够好，像是自动切换目标修正视角的功能在无双割草里就很需要。 总的来说，《传颂之物：斩 2》在忠于原作剧情的基础上，以3D演出+无双割草的方式让玩家回顾经典，各方面比起《斩1》都有了很好的改进，加上一些新增的情节给老玩家的体验也很棒。绝对是一部成功的割草游戏，也是合格的粉丝向作品。 [quote]关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/36224058/]老实人鉴赏家 [/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/laoshirenLSR]老实人评测[/url]：独立游戏爱好者聚集地，黄油绅士交流中心。 不错过游戏的亮点，不放过游戏的槽点，带给玩家最直观的测评感受。[/quote]

《传颂之物：斩2》是一款由AQUAPLUS开发，DMM GAMES与Shiravune发行的3D动作RPG,游戏最开始是2021年在PS登录，2026年才在steam平台登录。 本作主线剧情“白皇演武”以《二人的白皇》为基础，奥修特尔在与武赖的战斗中因过度使用假面的力量而导致死亡，哈克继承其意志带上了假面与猫音配合伪装成“奥修特尔”，对外宣称那场战斗死去的是“哈克”；在这之后协助公主“杏树”与伙伴们在战乱中夺回大和。 虽基于《二人的白皇》，但在演出形式上面进行了大规模的整改，不同于以往的立绘展示，本作在剧情演出上更多地采用3d人物对话的同时加入动作，并辅以2d立绘于左边文字框来演绎整个故事，本作是老游戏登录，现在来看3d建模略显粗糙，画质肯定不能指望了，但勇于创新的做法还是值得鼓励的；“斩1、2”将游戏玩法进行改变，在我看来其实在一定程度上进行了扩圈尝试，试着将本来对因战旗玩法而无感的群体进行了一次大胆的示好，同时作为一款粉丝向游戏还能让粉丝在回味之前熟悉的剧情走向时看到部分新增剧情，但有一点要说明清楚，本作剧情还是有点碎的，同时较于《二人的白皇》少了许多细节，剧情有不少跳过，对追求更好剧情体验的玩家还是建议先玩《二人的白皇》再来决定是否入手这部。 本作玩法上主要通过每个关卡的通关推进剧情与角色养成增加游戏时长，可操控角色数量随着剧情推进与模式的解锁月越来越多，每个角色有派生动作和连招，打击感欠佳，索敌感觉怪怪的，经常给我视角锁到一个很难受的位置，游戏内可调节难度，即使开局选好了，在游戏内还是能更改的，这给了玩家自由选择的空间，在低难度下进入关卡直接当无双莽就行了，对养成不感冒的玩家还是比较友好的，选高难的玩家则要适当注意自己角色的养成与卷轴佩戴，这样打起来才会更加舒适，遗憾的是想全角色体验只能高难度。 总的来说，《传颂之物：斩2》的玩法在一定程度上对自家ip进行了一次大胆尝试，部分3d剧情打斗与bgm演出可圈可点，粉丝可在适合的价格内自行选择购入，对想要更好剧情体验的玩家还是推荐玩原作，入坑后再来尝试本作。 [quote]关注&加入∶[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45540934/admin/reviews_manage/]深澜探索者[/url][/quote]

I hate to post this as a negative, but I'll put the TL;DR at the start: Good game, barebones PC port, iffy English translation in some spots (parts from the original script, and some parts from the new content for this game), along with some formatting and grammar issues in a few spots. Recommended if: You're already a fan of the franchise & have already played Mask of Truth/二人の白皇, or You want a pretty decent hack-and-slash and don't care much about the story (it's cut down quite a lot from the original), and If you don't mind the lack of PC specific options Otherwise it's a hard sell, even though the gameplay itself is pretty fun. Vastly improved over Zan 1 in every way in terms of gameplay, and now that I can actually understand the text, I can make the hardest difficulties a cakewalk. Now then, my concerns are twofold: the PC experience and the localization. It's a fun game, just as fun as the PS4 version, which I played a bit after release despite it being in Japanese. However, it being a straight port of the PS4 version with English subs is part of the problem, as it has basically no extra options given the fact that it's been ported to PC. The game runs mostly fine, yes, but for a PC release, it's very bare-bones. It's a very slim chance, but I hope modders can do something about it, anyway. (Edit: Since I was asked to clarify, I'll detail that lack of anything in terms of PC-specific options, that being basically everything aside from window size changing, screen mode, cursor display time (how long it stays on screen), and background behavior (pause on tab out). No increase in FPS, no graphics upscaling of any kind, absolutely nothing. This was also the case for Zan 1, so my hope for it being included in Zan 2 was very much misguided. I'm actually arguably more bothered by this than the latter issue, in spite of how much more time I gave to the latter.) In terms of the localization, I'm highly particular about that sort of thing, and while I knew that they wouldn't change anything from the original script, I wasn't really holding my breath for that to get fixed. The new stuff is sort of fine in spots, but also noticeably different in others, which I find to be unfortunately common. All the same, that's my personal tastes, and I know I'm the outlier. In terms of things that are purely formatting/grammar/punctuation mistakes, anyway, I've been gathering screenshots if no one else has been, and I'll see if I can submit them directly somehow. (Edit: As was mentioned in the one comment, I'll reclarify what I said. Truthfully, you can easily find worse in the way of localization, but there being problems that could very easily have translated "properly" (I.E. to my standard) will bother me nonetheless. Again, I am the outlier on this sort of thing, I know, so this is more so for people that are as bothered about that sort of thing as I am. I did, however, come across an actually empty text box that defaulted to some sample text, which definitely should be fixed. I'm not sure how that even got missed, especially since I only saw it the one time. I could go through the entire game and point out all of the lines that bother me, however, that's time consuming and I'd have to be actually paid to do so, personally.) Don't get me wrong, I'm quite a fan of the franchise, and I was going to get this game regardless, but I can't say that I'm not a little disappointed with my aforementioned personal problems. I'm glad that they didn't release it at the usual $60 USD, at least. I'm only about halfway through the game right now, and I'm really taking my time with it, but I plan to 100% it again much like I did back on PS4 a couple of years ago. (Edit: Also, beware of 100%ing this game. The grind assistants in that one game mode is hell. Pray to whatever deity you believe in to bless you with gacha luck for those.)

本作与斩1一样同样为无双玩法，剧情为简化版的《二人的白皇》，但是与1代相比在游戏体量和玩法上都有了大幅度的提升，并且对部分重要的剧情专门做了过场动画，整体的体验比1代要好很多，算是很有诚意的一部粉丝向作品了。 2代的故事模式共有19个章节，包括战记（主线任务）和武士传（支线任务）两种，部分章节需要打完战记和武士传才能解锁，可控角色基本上都是剧情指定的人选，所以最好对每个角色的招式都要有所了解，默认的难度一还是挺简单的，个人体感从难度五开始才有一定的挑战性，如果只是想过剧情那建议直接难度一通关。 除了故事模式外，本作还有虎穴、梦幻演武、远征任务等玩法。虎穴为100层的爬塔玩法，每层需要清理完几波敌人后才能继续前进，每5层会有一个存档点，退出后下次可以从存档点继续开始。梦幻演武由6场杂兵战和2场Boss战组成，完成3场杂兵战后才能打1场Boss战，全部打完才算成功。远征任务就是普通的杂兵战，但打完一场后会有个CD时间，需要在其他模式完成几场战斗后才能重新打。 本作的战斗手感比1代还是好了不少，虽然还是没啥打击感，但动作没有那么僵硬了，主要问题出在视角锁定上，如果遇到一个喜欢乱动的敌人打起来会很难受，因为视角会跟着他一直转，到角落的时候甚至连人都看不到，大多数时候不锁定反而更加舒服，感觉还是技术力不够造成的，算是一个较大的遗憾吧。 总的来说，斩2与斩1相比可以说是比较有诚意了，特别是几段重要的过场动画重现了原作的经典场面，非常推荐老粉重温一遍。 [quote] 加入[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/ADZZW]爱の榨汁屋[/url]&关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/34815366/]爱の鉴赏家[/url]，用爱品鉴世间作品，用心流淌真情实感。 [/quote]

对于《传颂之物》这个经典IP，相信大家也是略有耳闻，该系列最早是发自2002年的PC，经过多年的发酵，游戏也从最开始的战棋，视觉小说，转变为如今的割草无双，也是给IP粉丝展现了不一样的美。 《受赞颂者斩2》作为《传颂之物》的衍生作品，其游戏类型和原本的是不一样的，理论上来说这种从战棋文字冒险转变到割草无双这种玩法模式是比较大胆的， 但就从结果来说，AQUAPLUS又是比较成功的，至少斩2给人玩起来的感觉还是比较不错的。也许是因为之前已经有过经验（去年年底zan1的发售）在原有内容的基础上剧情以及玩法都有很大提升。 尤其是剧情方面，在无双这个同类型的玩法下来说，本作剧情占比会更大。 不过缺点也是有的，这两天玩下来最差的地方不是手感而是锁头，第一次遇到我锁头还会打歪的，身边一堆敌人，哥们搁那打空气。。。 回归游戏层次，ZAN2给人的感觉就是比较丰富的，战斗的时候玩家可以操控最多4名成员组成的小队，如果是键鼠玩家只需要按动1/2/3/4就会变换角色，在常规的无双游戏中，本作是更为灵活。 不仅如此，每个角色的招式和技能都是独特的，玩家可以自由使用每个角色，搭配不同技能让自己游戏体验拉满，另外角色很丰富，剧情越推进越能爽玩。 本作的剧情承接《二人的白皇》，在上一作的结局中，奥修特尔耗尽了力量，濒临死亡。在临终前，他将象征着“受赞颂者”的假面托付给了哈克，让哈克代替自己的身份，以“奥修特尔”的名义继续活下去。 至于一作和二作的关联，剧情上肯定是接着的，所以注重剧情的玩家可以试着先玩一再玩二，至于将游戏体验看的比较重要的可以直接体验二作，手感这块没话说。 游戏难度分为难1到难15，难度系数越低越好打，系数越高体验则相对越好。其中一点就是有些角色会在高难度中解锁，游戏总共有二十一个角色，然初始角色只有九位，所以想获得更全的游戏体验，是可以他自己去挑战高难度。 游戏的玩法主要是围绕着故事模式进行，除此之外还有虎穴爬塔，远征任务等玩法。玩法多样性的初衷是不错的，但是刷刷刷的地方也多就很难受。 其实总的感觉还是不错的，虽然无效锁头让人蛋疼，但是剧情人物立绘都是不错的，。 另外zan2的标签虽然是动作无双游戏，但在不成熟表现下，反而是游戏的剧情画面会相对突出。 [quote] 专业评测 | 独立视角 | 帮你发现好游戏 欢迎关注 [url= https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45363287/]“🎮丨游戏高手鉴赏组丨🎮”[/url] [/quote]

A wonderful iteration of the final and best Utawarerumono game in the trilogy. Like Zan 1, Zan 2 tells a shortened, summarized story of the Mask of Truth but changed the gameplay from a tactic RPG to an Action RPG that is akin to the musou series but with less enemies on screen that are way more aggressive and pose much more of a threat to the player. Zan 2 is an elevation from Zan 1 in every way. Graphically it is more beautiful. The story that its tells, though concise, is more involved and true to the original. The side story that it offers also gives light hearted exploration of the other characters that are quite entertaining to sit through as well. Then there is challenge. Zan 2 introduces expeditions, tiger dens and dream arenas as end game contents for players that have finished the main story to continuously grind for the best build and completion. All the characters are also crafted and unique. Even those that uses the same weapons or are supposed to be clones of one another have their own unique and distinct playstyle that makes all of them possess their own strength and weaknesses. There are varieties of boss fights, previous characters, all with different moves and mechanics, requiring different approaches rather than to just button mashes as one would expect from a musou type game. Paired this with a highly enjoyable gameplay and this game is a package that is so great that it should be played even if the player have experienced this story before. Highly recommended. This is a great game.

一，就玩法来说我只能给7分，但是糟糕的刷刷刷体验结合下来还是不及格 虽然本作的可玩性有了显著的增加，但白金肝度和前作相比更加恼人了，成长性依旧也是匹配不上肝度，以至于虎之穴通关满级后纯粹在做无用功。我还以为技能盘效果能叠加呢，结果只能择一，而且旧技能盘盈余的bp居然还不能继承。我不知道这个“还原”仪式有什么卵用。要是做成无双大蛇那样，每次转生都能获得一个可以叠加的技能盘加一大截属性搞个5转不是香爆了，让人后期也能合法体验一下风灵月影般的数值。 二，打击手感奇差，动作表现很无语 叶水你要不要看看你那个B锁定是人玩的吗，奇羽琉那个平a终结蓄力箭根本就不能锁。还有就是这个游戏的碰瓷技能纯属影响输出节奏，比如奥修的扇子，左近的背身刀，交互了也没有打击感。然后感觉怪更稀了，大家的攻击范围变小了，除非用大白根本割不爽。因为大白不能 登场以至于梦幻演武刷助战是最做坐牢的。 三，新剧情还是太少了，原作党很不爽 我觉得武人传好多都是废话，发糖力度不够，没有给原作结局来一个补完我觉得还是太遗憾了。比起做什么100层虎之穴，不如搞100回杏树的水户黄门微服私访之旅，然后给大结局后的世界多来点笔墨。或者至少给一个久远和大白重逢的场景也行啊。我觉得这个剧情很难让原作党满足吧。一百层大战奥修特尔的剧情也完全看不够。 四，这游戏有啥重复可玩性吗？ 我说真的我本来很想打一个好评，毕竟从17年就玩完了二白，然后steam登陆后，我也把叶水的作品除了白色相簿1全部都白金了。对叶水那真是爱之深，但是凭良心讲，我觉得原作的二人的白皇的红白比试真的很好玩，哪怕全刷完了，就自己打自己还随机组队都乐趣无穷。但是本作是3d化集大成，但是却没有什么可以反复游玩带来乐趣的玩法，我很失望。

Well, after playing through the game, I will say it's a major improvement from the first ZAN game. There are a ton of things to keep you occupied and the story does a decent job at covering Mask of Truth with the side stories being the best of it. Gameplay wise, the controls are feel more fluid then the first game, even though it's still a bit rough around the edges. Skill/buff mechanics do feel a bit bloated and slow to upgrade, so unless you're a perfectionist, there isn't much an incitive to commit to a perfect build, making all the extra fluff feel like empty calories. My biggest gripe with the game is the fact you don't really have a way to get used to the characters as there's always some kind of timer rushing you to just get things done, or simply a lack of punchable enemies, so a training mode would have been perfect. Overall, it's a fun game for fans of the series who want a different experience, but if you're interested in the Utawarerumono series, just play the main games, and if you're looking for a musou game, know this feels more like a team arena fighter, which is not to say that's a bad thing, but it may not be what you're expecting. Taking all this into account, how much you enjoy this game depends on how much you like the Utawarerumono universe.
